scaleSteps.name: Micro
scaleSteps.usage: Label-to-input gap, icon-to-text gap, badge chips
scaleSteps.usageZh: 标签与输入框间距 (gap-1.5)、图标与文字间隙、角标内嵌

scaleSteps.name: Tight
scaleSteps.usage: Button row spacing, segmented control gap, actions
scaleSteps.usageZh: 按钮组横向间隙 (gap-2)、分段控件内嵌、工具栏操作

scaleSteps.name: Compact
scaleSteps.usage: Card sub-item spacing, compact form field gap
scaleSteps.usageZh: 卡片子项间距 (gap-2.5)、致密表单字段纵向间隙

scaleSteps.name: Normal
scaleSteps.usage: Standard form field gap, list item vertical spacing
scaleSteps.usageZh: 标准表单字段纵向间距 (space-y-3.5)、紧凑列表行距

scaleSteps.name: Section
scaleSteps.usage: Form body to header/footer gap, inner card section
scaleSteps.usageZh: 表单正文与页眉/页脚间隙 (space-y-4)、卡片内部分区
